test_cat_accessor: test the CategoricalAccessor for basic operations like set_categories, reorder_categories, and remove_unused_categories
test_cat_accessor_api: test the .cat accessor API to verify it returns a CategoricalAccessor and raises AttributeError on non-category Series
test_categorical_delegations: test that Series delegates .categories, .codes, .ordered, and cat methods to the underlying Categorical
test_dt_accessor_api_for_categorical: test datetime accessor (.dt) on categorical Series with date_range, period_range, and timedelta_range indexes
